text:
DeployBot: kicking off staged rollout service=inference-api model=v2.5.0 cohort=LATAM initial=5% window=03:00-04:00UTC `/deploy start --staged=5%`
Leah: quick heads up: this includes a small tokenizer tweak + attention fallback change. Request to watch token_count and p99.
Tom (oncall): holding until p99 and auth look stable for 5m.
Infra: pinning to gc-tuned nodes and setting hotstart-delay=6s.
DeployBot: canary at 5%. hooks: auth.fail, latency.p99, tokenizer.token_count.delta, request.5xx.
MetricsBot: at +2m token_count.delta=+1.8% (warn 2.0%), latency.p99 +15ms.
Leah: suggest hold for another 5m, then bump if stable.
Tom (oncall): auth OK, no increase in failures. p99 within threshold. Holding -> proceed after 5m soak.
DeployBot: bumping to 20% now `/deploy bump --staged=20%`
MetricsBot: after bump token_count.delta=+3.6%, long_prompt.recall.delta=+1.9% (threshold 1.5%).
Leah: that's a regression on long prompts. Proposing stop/rollback.
Tom (oncall): calling stop. Rolling back to v2.4.8.
DeployBot: rollback initiated `/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.4.8`
Infra: scaling back; expect warmstart bleed ~45s.
ReleaseNotesBot: note added: "v2.5.0 LATAM canary halted after tokenization/recall regression at 20% bump; rolled back to v2.4.8. Action: revert tokenizer tweak, run extended long-prompt soak."
Leah: will open PR and schedule extended tests.
DeployBot: thread closed by automation. If follow-up, open a new thread.
